name: professor-lms-publishing-skills
description: Preview and explicitly publish professor-approved content to Canvas, Moodle, or Telegram.

interface.shortDescription: Publish approved course content to LMS and Telegram.
interface.longDescription: Three focused skills prepare, preview, validate, and explicitly publish course announcements, pages, messages, and documents through Canvas, Moodle, or Telegram connection profiles. A shared TypeScript CLI keeps credentials local, redacts secrets, and makes dry-run planning the default.
